recordings.title: Wall bait · controlled hold (native)
recordings.description: Original simulator rendering via Environment.draw. Controlled 70-second wall trap, one stationary bait and one predator. Every 0.1-second tick recorded; artificial flat terrain.

recordings.title: Wall handoff · guide sacrificed (native)
recordings.description: Original simulator rendering. Controlled 60-second wall hold after the guide is captured at 0.9 seconds. Both baits start with 150 energy. Uses privileged exact geometry; no food or new predators. Shows a costly handoff, not safe acquisition in a generated map.

recordings.title: Water bait · acquire from land (native)
recordings.description: Original simulator rendering. Controlled 40.9-second acquisition attempt: both agents begin on the predator's land side; a dry-shore launch and timed second bait draw it into the river. First bait depletes at 38.9 seconds; the other is captured later. Uses known synthetic straight-river geometry and initial poses, with no food or replacements. Shows acquisition followed by failure, not sustainable control on a generated map.

recordings.title: Water bait · prepared fruit banks (native)
recordings.description: Original simulator rendering. Controlled 120-second hold with two baits, a 50-unit-wide straight river and rich prepared mature-fruit banks. Baits use cached public observations plus known initial poses and river geometry; max_age is fixed at 120. Both remain alive at the horizon. This does not establish reliable food supply or trap acquisition on generated maps.

recordings.title: Water bait · unfed narrow river (state)
recordings.description: Lightweight state rendering. Controlled 64-second, 50-unit-wide straight river: first bait starves at 63.5 seconds. Cached public observations plus known initial poses and river geometry. Two 150-energy baits; no food. Demonstrates maintenance limits.

recordings.title: Water bait · wide river failure (state)
recordings.description: Lightweight state rendering. Controlled 100-unit-wide straight river, arranged starting positions; one bait dies at 2.1 seconds. Uses cached public observations with known fixture geometry. Included as a failure comparison, not a general result.

recordings.title: Sprinter decoy · adaptive (state)
recordings.description: Lightweight state rendering. Controlled 39.1-second finite-food decoy run ending in capture. Uses cached public observations and clear-ground odometry in an arranged arena; initial energy 500. Not a generated-map policy validation.

recordings.title: Predator displacement · controlled (state)
recordings.description: Lightweight state rendering. Controlled 60-second attempt to lead a predator away, then leave. Assigned waypoint and privileged exact bait position; arranged forest arena and finite prepared fruit. Not an observation-only competition policy.

recordings.description: Lightweight state rendering. Complete 1,023.7-second local game. Tree-oriented foraging, age-aware births, six-agent population cap. Frames every 0.5 seconds; events every tick.

recordings.title: Greedy forager · seed 1 (state)
recordings.description: Lightweight state rendering. Complete 68.4-second comparison run on seed 1. Immediate fruit collection and unrestricted reproduction when reserves permit.
